summary: Created `desk:apps:tally` and verified counting, the zero floor, reset, and Enter saving `1` to `desk:tally`.

files.desk:apps:tally:
app 'Tally'
task start()
  set n to 0
  when exists('desk:tally')
    set n to number(read('desk:tally'))
  done
  give {n: n}
done
task key(s, k)
  when k is '+'
    set s.n to s.n + 1
  or when k is '-' and s.n > 0
    set s.n to s.n - 1
  or when k is 'r'
    set s.n to 0
  or when k is 'enter'
    write('desk:tally', s.n)
  done
  give s
done
task draw(s)
  show(1, 1, 'Count: ' & s.n)
done
